title: Help with RMMZ: Failed to initialize graphics

posts.author: Pabaraga
posts.body:
I installed the free trial version of both RPG Maker MZ and MV, here's the problem:
RPG Maker MZ works perfectly, however, when I try to playtest a game, I get the error: "Error: Failed to initialize graphics."
Now, RPG Maker MV doesn't work at all, I open it, I get the window of product activation, I click "Continue", then I get the title screen, the programme opens and it gives me a white screen, I already tried the Mesa OpenGL thing, it got worse, now Windows gives me a loading window and it says that the programme cannot initiate.
I have a HP Laptop model: 14-ck0001fa with Intel Celeron N4000 together with Windows 8.1.
Is there any solution to my problem?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Pabaraga said:
I already tried the Mesa OpenGL thing,
Click to expand...
that has no longer been neccessary for many years. The entire OGL workarounds from earlier version were only intended to update your display driver's OGL package if the default one was for an older OGL.
But the correct drivers have included the more modern OGL for several years.
Now, what both errors mean is that your computer's display driver does not support OGL. That can have three different reasons:
Your display chip is too old to support OGL - we can't tell because you didn't mention what display card/chip is inside your computer.
You have installed a Microsoft driver instead of the correct driver from the card manufacturer. The problem here is that OGL is direct competition to the Microsoft DirectX library, and many Microsoft drivers have only old or incomplete OGL support as a result.
Or the installed driver might have been damaged.
for the first case nothing can be done, but in both the second and third case the solution is to download the setup for the correct driver from the manufacturer's website and use that to manually (NEVER automatically) replace the driver.
DO NOT use the official Windows driver update. That will never work because it will consider the installed driver to be the best, no matter if it is wrong or defective.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
MZ minimum requirements from Steam page:
Processor:
Intel Core i3-4340 or better
Memory:
8 GB RAM
Graphics:
Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
The N processor is lower than an i3, and all those N processor PCs I know of will not meet the video card requirement or the memory requirement.
Sorry, you probably need a better PC to run MZ.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
ATT_Turan said:
that laptop doesn't appear to have even an onboard graphics chip.
Click to expand...
without a graphics chip, it wouldn't be able to create a signal for a display.
What this likely means is that the laptop has no dedicated graphics chip, but an integrated chip combined with the regular chipset.
Those were developed because that reduces both price and power consumption, but at the disadvantage of having a lot less graphics power.
In my original post above I was assuming the display driver had been damaged by the try to force OGL only only listed the other options for completeness, but this sounds more and more like the computer isn't OGL compatible at all.
